split: sha256 of canonical 18-feature row; first 8 hex digits modulo 100; train <70, development <85, test >=85
selection: lowest mean development MAE divided by training target standard deviation
final_fit: train plus development; test used once, no tuning afterward
domain: all features within final training extrema; nearest normalized transformed training RMS distance <= 1.05 * training leave-one-out 99th percentile
transform: log10 for positive features spanning >=100x in training; otherwise identity; fit on training only
scope: single public TOPCon dataset; simulated/research labels, not new device experiments or original AutoGluon recovery
